note: Superior NF (Laurentian district) rustic campground by the Big Rice Lake boat launch, 14 mi north of Virginia; the forest says its sites suit 'small RVs and tents'. Each site has room for one vehicle and one towed vehicle; at most nine people. Big Rice Lake is a shallow wild-rice lake; the launch suits only small boats and canoes. --Claude
summary: FS page read (updated Oct 5, 2026): drive-in rustic campground, 3 sites 'suitable for small RVs and tents', 1 vault outhouse, no fees, one vehicle plus one towed vehicle a site, nine people max. Status shows 'Closed-No fees or services' / 'Site Partially Closed' now (the off season). Not waterfront confirmed.
